overall_summary: Data indicates that 'self respect' videos anchored on tangible everyday digital/phone interactions (like pinned chats, reply waiting, or status lists) perform better than abstract emotional topics like 'रात के ख्याल' or general 'ओवरथिंकिंग'. However, overall views remain low across the board, requiring continued refinement of the micro-hooks.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Self Respect Status Story' (rwOUYo_hayQ - 41 views) and 'जब रिप्लाई का इंतज़ार खत्म हो जाए' (wFimeeP_aVc - 35 views) outpace abstract concepts.
winning_patterns.action: Keep tying emotional self-respect to specific smartphone actions or everyday UI elements.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'रात के ख्याल' (uIbMpCjVutQ - 5 views) underperform significantly compared to active self-respect choices.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely passive mood descriptions; anchor every mood to an active realization or physical action.
